inputs.text: Bloomberg’s framing is the tell: while rising energy prices, canceled flights, and death and destruction make people worldwide ask when the Iran war will stop, Israel is cast as uniquely willing to keep going. That contrast turns continuation into “public resolve” and hides the interests that may be sustaining it. And the account cuts off after “until”—an omission that leaves the real question hanging: who benefits from keeping this war going?
